comparator.name: Bio-Pharmaceutical Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: The live Leiden Study Guide product identifies a current 180-EC Bio-Pharmaceutical Sciences bachelor with three 60-EC years. Years 1 and 2 are fully compulsory and integrate chemistry, molecular and cell biology, biochemistry, physiology, genetics, quantitative methods, pharmacology, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, toxicology, bio-analysis, drug design and synthesis, biopharmacy and laboratory work. Year 3 consists of 14 EC of compulsory academic and modern-drug-development work, one 30-EC specialisation and a 16-EC bachelor research project. Bio-Pharmaceutical Sciences and Pharmacy is selected under the broad-academic-identity rule; its five official modules total 30 EC. The bachelor research project is represented by its three official components: Practical Work (12 EC), Bachelor Thesis (3 EC) and Bachelor Oral Presentation (1 EC).

routeSelection.basis: The current generic Bio-Pharmaceutical Sciences bachelor offers two formal 30-EC third-year specialisations: Computational Approaches in Drug Discovery and Development, and Bio-Pharmaceutical Sciences and Pharmacy. The Bio-Pharmaceutical Sciences and Pharmacy route most broadly continues the named programme's experimental drug-development identity across formulation and analysis, pharmaceutical technology, quality, pharmacotherapy and the pharmacist's societal role, while the computational route is a narrower methodological specialisation. The route is selected before and independently of UCR fit.

exception.reason: Leiden Bio-Pharmaceutical Sciences is an integrated experimental drug-science degree. Its compulsory spine combines general and organic chemistry, molecular and cell biology, biochemistry, physiology, genetics, pharmacology, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, ADME, toxicology, bio-analysis, drug design and synthesis, biopharmacy and biophysics, multiple discipline-specific laboratories, modern drug development, a 30-EC specialisation and a 16-EC bachelor research project. The selected broad route adds pharmaceutical formulation and analysis, technology, quality and pharmacotherapy. UCR offers a strong molecular-biomedical cluster, one pharmacology course, quantitative and data-science methods, and one life-science laboratory, but no chemistry sequence, medicinal or pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, drug-design and synthesis sequence, pharmaceutical analysis, formulation science, pharmaceutical technology and quality, staged drug-science laboratories or comparable bio-pharmaceutical research capstone. A 24-course UCR programme would therefore become general biomedical science rather than a defensible Bio-Pharmaceutical Sciences comparator.
exception.curriculumContext: The live 2026-2027 Leiden curriculum accounts for exactly 180 EC: 60 EC of compulsory first-year foundations, 60 EC of compulsory second-year drug-science and biomedical study, and a third year comprising 14 EC of compulsory academic and modern-drug-development work, the selected 30-EC Bio-Pharmaceutical Sciences and Pharmacy specialisation and a 16-EC bachelor research project. The specialisation is selected under the broad-academic-identity rule before UCR fit is considered.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 records in the current GitHub main data/reference/ucr_courses_enriched.xlsx (SHA-256 7bf6c2ae9de0837086ec741c27bd94ed7e85dff2d25bde619ecd50cc4d685879), including names, descriptions, outline-derived profiles, disciplines, topics, methods, prerequisites and planned availability. HCBGATE101 Foundation of Life, Health & Biomedicine, HCBLIFE211 Molecular Cell Biology, HCBLIFE212 Human Physiology, HCBLIFE213 Biochemistry, HCBLIFE311 Molecular Pathology & Genetics, HCBBIOM211 Functional Anatomy, HCBBIOM311 Pharmacology, HCBBIOM312 Infection & Immunity and HCBBIOM313 Mechanisms of Disease provide substantial molecular, physiological, disease and medicines foundations. HCBLIFE214 Life Science Laboratory adds biochemical and molecular laboratory work, including bacterial techniques, protein production, DNA analysis and basic bioinformatics. HCBPSYC211 Statistics & Experimental Methods, DISGATE102 Mathematical Methods, DISMATH314 Probability & Statistics, DISGATE101 Introduction to Programming, DISDATA111 Introduction to Data Science and DISDATA211 Machine Learning provide transferable quantitative and computational support. The workbook contains no general- or organic-chemistry sequence, medicinal or pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, ADME course, bio-analysis of drugs, drug-design and synthesis sequence, biopharmacy and formulation science, pharmaceutical technology or quality, pharmacotherapy sequence, organic-synthesis or pharmaceutical-analysis laboratory, staged drug-development practical formation, or 16-EC bio-pharmaceutical research project. HCBBIOM311 is one broad pharmacology course and HCBLIFE214 one life-science laboratory; together with the strong biomedical cluster they still cannot replace the target's chemistry, drug-design, dosage-form, analytical and experimental-pharmacy spine. No academically honest 24-course closest match can therefore be formed.
